capabilities: Summarize YouTube videos by fetching their real captions/transcripts
Summarize Reddit threads and web articles from page contents
Insert Target/Words/Summary key-value output into the note
Apply an optional focus instruction or custom prompt to summaries
Configure the Gemini model and default summary word count
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The author states this is a first project built with about 65% AI assistance and invites other developers to review and improve the code. Installation is manual (no community plugin store listing described); the API key is stored locally in the vault.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to fetch YouTube transcripts or web page content and turn a pasted link into a summary inside a note.

relations.evidence: summarizes YouTube videos, Reddit threads, and web articles directly inside your Obsidian notes using the Google Gemini API

summary: AI summarizer that turns YouTube, Reddit, and web article links into Target/Words/Summary note text using the Google Gemini API.
